name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenInfoWindow

name: maybe_Field_Npc_OnActionEnd

Otherwise it requests 0x10 or 0x11 from the root singleton state and commits through the prompt reference.

name: maybe_Work_RowIdIsNamed
signature: u8 maybe_Work_RowIdIsNamed(u32* work, const u32* id)
summary: Predicate over the 20-entry 0x8C-byte row table: counts the leading rows whose wide name is shorter than 7 characters, whose u16 at +0 is non-zero and whose id at +0x88 is not -1, then scans those rows backwards and returns 1 when the u32 key matches *id, else 0.
evidence: The old 'FindLastNamedRow' contradicted the disassembly: 0x0066ADF8..0x0066AE30 decrements r0 but finally returns sb (0/1), i.e. a membership test used by Ui_ListData_BuildEntries as a one-byte flag in the packed entry. The readable C only survived as the mis-marked wcslen call (0x00100B74), so the name stays maybe_ at 0.4.

name: Work_CountNamedRows
summary: Counts the leading valid rows of the 20-entry 0x8C-byte table at work+0x24A98 (+0x783C): a row counts while its wide name is shorter than 7 characters, its u16 at +0 is non-zero and its id at +0x88 is not -1; the first failing row ends the count. Ui_ListData_BuildEntries modes 3 and 6 use it to size the list.
evidence: Although the readable C only shows the truncated wcslen tail, the disassembly at 0x0066B1B0..0x0066B1F4 is a complete count loop with exactly these three tests and returns the counter; its caller Ui_ListData_BuildEntries (mode 3/6) uses the result as the entry count, which matches the name.
